\section{Algorithms}
\begin{algorithm}
\caption{Loop}\label{alg:loop}
\begin{algorithmic}[1]
\Procedure{Run}{$n$}
  \For{$i = 1$ to $n$}\label{line:for}
    \State \Call{Work}{$i$} \Comment{do work}
  \EndFor
  \State \Return $n$
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}
Line~\ref{line:for} of Algorithm~\ref{alg:loop}. Cite \citet{lamport94} and \citep{knuth84,lamport94}.
Notes: \citep[see][p.~5]{knuth84}; author only: \citeauthor{lamport94}; year only: \citeyear{knuth84}.
